pdf.comparisonNote: The percentage change is only calculated when the previous period had activity. “No comparison” means there is no base to calculate it from, not that the change was zero.
pdf.communicationsNote: No delivery, open or click rates are recorded: the system does not store email delivery status. There is no WhatsApp tracking either.
pdf.methodTimezone: All periods are interpreted in ODL's business timezone ({zone}), not the server's and not the browser's.
pdf.methodPeriod: Periods are half-open: they include the start instant and exclude the end, so two consecutive periods neither overlap nor leave gaps.
pdf.methodApprovalRate: The approval rate is approved ÷ (approved + not eligible). Cancelled applications are excluded as administrative closures carrying no credit decision. With no decisions in the period the rate does not exist and is shown as “No decisions”.
pdf.methodFunnel: The public form journey has been recorded since {date}. Before that date it was not measured: the absence of events does not mean an absence of applicants.
pdf.methodFunnelNone: The public form journey is not recorded yet.
pdf.methodAttribution: Campaign attribution has been captured since {date}. Earlier leads appear as “not measured”, which is not the same as having arrived directly.
pdf.methodAttributionNone: Campaign attribution is not captured yet.
pdf.methodApprovedNotDisbursed: The approved amount represents recorded approval decisions; it does NOT represent disbursements made. The system does not record disbursements, balances or a loan portfolio.
pdf.methodSnapshotVsPeriod: Some figures cover the period (by the date of the event) and others are the current state at the moment this report was generated. Each section says which.
pdf.methodUnavailable: Compliance and WhatsApp metrics are not included: the system does not hold the data that would support them.

methodology.timezone: All dates and times are expressed in Panama time (America/Panama), not server time. A report day starts and ends at Panamanian midnight.
methodology.populations: «Applications» are those created within the period. «Leads» are public form submissions received within the period. These are two distinct populations and must not be subtracted from one another: a lead may become an application weeks later, outside the period.
methodology.applicationNumber: The application number is assigned when the application is formalized. An application still in draft has no number and that cell is left empty: none has been invented. Since it is the key used to cross-reference the «Documents» and «Follow-ups» sheets, rows belonging to a draft application cannot be linked by number; they are identified by client.
methodology.documents: The «Documents» sheet lists the requirements OF THIS PERIOD'S APPLICATIONS, with their current status. The Summary figure «Documents uploaded» counts files UPLOADED DURING THE PERIOD, which may belong to earlier applications. The two numbers answer different questions and are not expected to match.
methodology.followUps: Follow-ups recorded within the period are listed, even when the application predates it. The advisor's internal note is NOT exported: it is free text written for internal use and must not leave the CRM inside a file that gets forwarded.
methodology.approvedTopic: «Approved amount» is not money paid out
methodology.approved: The approved amount is the value of a credit DECISION. ODL does not record disbursements: there is no table, no date and no balance. This report does NOT represent disbursements made, placed volume or outstanding balance, and no total of this column should be presented as such.
methodology.approvalRate: It is approvals over decisions made (approved plus not eligible), not over applications created. Cancelled applications are excluded: an administrative closure is not a judgement on the applicant. An application still under review counts on neither side. When there were no decisions the cell reads «No decisions» instead of a percentage: a 0% would say everything reviewed was rejected, and nothing was reviewed. The change on this row is in percentage POINTS and appears only when both periods had decisions.
methodology.delta: The previous period is one of the same length immediately preceding this one. When the previous period was zero, the «Change %» column is deliberately left empty: going from 0 to 7 is not a percentage increase, it is a change with no base to compute one from.
methodology.empty: An empty cell means the value is NOT KNOWN, not that it is zero. The zeros in this workbook are measured zeros. Filling the gaps with 0 would make «we do not know» add up as «nothing».
methodology.funnel: «Stalled» and «Abandoned» are computed from the time elapsed since the last activity up to the moment this file was generated, using the same thresholds as the Dashboard (72 hours and 7 days). A lead can therefore change state between two exports of the same period without anything new having happened.
methodology.attributionCovered: This period is covered by attribution tracking. Even so, a submission without UTM or referrer does not mean «direct traffic»: it means no parameter arrived, which also happens with email clients, messaging apps and hand-copied links.
methodology.attributionUncovered: This period is NOT covered by attribution tracking, which started measuring later. Earlier submissions have no recorded source and appear empty here: no historical attribution has been reconstructed, because there is no evidence of what it was.
methodology.pii: Names, identification numbers, phone numbers, emails, employers and salaries of real people. Once downloaded it leaves the CRM's control: it cannot be revoked, traced or remotely deleted. Treat it as confidential information of ODL Financial Corporation and do not forward it outside company management.
methodology.excludedTopic: What this file does NOT contain
methodology.excluded: It contains no passwords, tokens, API keys, session identifiers, signed links, document content or files, storage paths, banking details or internal system identifiers. Nor the internal follow-up notes.
methodology.audit: Every generation of this file writes an event in the CRM history recording who generated it, when, which period it covers and how many rows it contains. The exported content is NOT stored in that record.
methodology.source: The figures on the «Summary», «Acquisition» and «Team» sheets come from the same function that feeds the Dashboard and the executive PDF report. They have not been recomputed here, so the same period yields the same number on screen, on paper and on this sheet.
